problem_summary.summary: Check whether a root-to-leaf path has values summing to the target; a path must end at a leaf.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: root and integer targetSum. Return a boolean.

brute_force.explanation: Enumerate every root-to-leaf sum with an explicit stack, store the sums, and search the resulting list for targetSum.
brute_force.correctness_idea: Every leaf is reached from the root by exactly one traversal path. The list therefore contains the sum of every valid candidate path, and membership matches the requirement.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) expected, including checking at most O(n) leaf sums after traversal.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(n) for leaf sums and the explicit traversal stack.

optimized.explanation: Search iteratively with a stack of node and remaining target values. At a leaf, succeed only if its value consumes the exact remainder; stop as soon as a match is found.
optimized.correctness_idea: For each stack entry, remaining is targetSum minus the values strictly above that node. A leaf matches exactly when subtracting its value leaves zero, which is equivalent to the full root-to-leaf sum equaling targetSum.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) worst case, with early termination when a matching leaf is reached.
optimized.space_complexity: O(h) to O(n) auxiliary for the explicit DFS stack, depending on tree shape.

steps.condition: This node is a leaf and the remainder is zero.

edge_cases.handling: Returns false because no root-to-leaf path exists.
